question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**platform**" means a raised level surface on which people or things can stand, but in this context, it refers to an opportunity or venue for expressing and addressing social issues. (मंच)
 
• In this context, **"platform" a**ppropriately fills the blank, indicating that literature can serve as a venue for discussing and shedding light on social issues.
 
• The other options: "**planking**," "**plank**," and "**planks**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *It can serve as a platform__ for social issues, shedding light on topics that need attention.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Planking (फर्श के तख्‍ते)**: means wooden boards used in building floors or surfaces.
 
• **Plank (तख्‍ता)**: means a long, thin, flat piece of timber, used especially in building and flooring.
 
• **Planks (तख्‍ते का बहुवचन)**: means multiple long, thin, flat pieces of timber.
